historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as a public garage. Designed by the O'Brien Brothers as Kay's Garage: three bays, two storeys, reinforced concrete, in a Tudor Revival manner. Kay's Garage, a public garage for twenty years.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criteria 1 and 3.
